meta.title: Yanyan toolkit
meta.description: Injects a context occupancy reading at the first step of every turn, reminds once per tier when occupancy crosses the handover, compact-soon, and nearly-full lines, and has a separate long-term-memory tier that says one line when its own watermark is reached; each tier fires once per session. A tier is turned off by setting its percentage to 0. The three ladder tiers each carry a write-handover checkbox (checked by default) that only controls whether that tier writes or updates the handover file; it never suppresses the reminder. All three tiers share one handover file (named with the date and the last 8 characters of the session id, next to the clock file): the handover tier writes it first, creating a five-section template only when the file does not exist; the compact-soon and nearly-full tiers append a timestamped update block to the same file, creating the template first if it is still missing. The injection only gains a pointer line (template created / handover exists / handover updated). The long-term-memory tier injects one sentence and writes no file. A periodic clock line (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm, with the current occupancy when readable) is appended every 6 hours by default and once at process start. Also reminds you to rotate to a new session on a chosen schedule (interval, weekly, or monthly), leaving a rotation marker line in the clock file. Every injection can be scoped per session (scopeSessions): leave it empty to reach all sessions, or list session ids or prefixes to inject only in matching sessions; the clock line is unaffected. Nothing is injected while occupancy is unavailable. Configure it under Settings, in the left navigation entry Yanyan toolkit — not on the plugin page.
